Metadata.title: SpendFlow
Metadata.description: Internal subscription and invoice reimbursement — upload, analyze, review, calculate, report.

Home.headline: Subscription invoices in. Monthly reimbursements out.
Home.body: Employees upload invoices in their own lane. Finance reviews once and exports a clean monthly reimbursement report.
Home.hintCalculate: Monthly cost rolls up in EUR
Home.hintReport: Finance gets a clean payout list
Home.demoBody: Registration needs Supabase mode (DEMO_MODE=false). Pick a persona to explore the product now.

missing_or_invalid_amount.label: Missing or invalid amount
missing_or_invalid_amount.description: No usable total was found on the invoice. Confirm the amount before approving.

missing_invoice_number.label: Missing invoice number
missing_invoice_number.description: The invoice number could not be read. Add it manually for audit and duplicate checks.

missing_invoice_date.label: Missing invoice date
missing_invoice_date.description: The invoice date was not extracted. Set the correct date before approval.

missing_billing_cycle.label: Missing billing cycle
missing_billing_cycle.description: Billing cycle (monthly, yearly, …) is unknown. Monthly cost may be wrong until you set it.

missing_billing_period.label: Missing billing period
missing_billing_period.description: Start or end of the billing period is missing. Period is used for monthly reimbursement math.

invalid_billing_period.label: Invalid billing period
invalid_billing_period.description: Period end is before period start. Correct the dates before approving.

unsupported_currency.label: Unsupported currency
unsupported_currency.description: This currency is not in the supported set (EUR, USD, GBP). Convert or edit the amount carefully.

duplicate_invoice_number.label: Possible duplicate
duplicate_invoice_number.description: Another non-rejected invoice already uses this invoice number. Check you are not reimbursing twice.

no_matching_subscription.label: No matching subscription
no_matching_subscription.description: No existing subscription was found for this employee and tool. Approving will create one.

employee_name_mismatch.label: Name mismatch
employee_name_mismatch.description: The name on the invoice does not clearly match the employee account. Verify ownership before approval.

price_change_detected.label: Price change
price_change_detected.description: The amount differs from the employee's current subscription price. Confirm before updating reimbursement.

missing_plan.label: Missing plan
missing_plan.description: Plan or tier name was not extracted. Optional, but useful for reporting.

mock_extraction_used.label: Mock extraction
mock_extraction_used.description: Live AI extraction was not used. Fields may be placeholders — review carefully.

fx_rate_fixed.label: Fixed FX rate
fx_rate_fixed.description: Converted with the company fixed USD→EUR rate ({rate}).

fx_rate_fallback.label: Fallback FX rate
fx_rate_fallback.description: Live exchange rates were unavailable, so a static fallback rate was used.

converted_from.label: Converted from {currency}
converted_from.descriptionUsd: Original amount was in {currency} and converted to EUR using the fixed company rate.
converted_from.descriptionOther: Original amount was in {currency} and converted to EUR for reimbursement.

fx_rate.label: FX rate {rate}
fx_rate.description: Exchange rate applied: {rate} EUR per 1 unit of the original currency.

fx_unavailable.label: FX unavailable ({currency})
fx_unavailable.description: Could not convert {currency} to EUR. Amount was left in the original currency.

unknown.label: {code}
unknown.description: Additional validation or processing note from upload.
